scientific_integrity: The signed formula has an analytic proof and a separate exact-arithmetic verifier; related size-biased law is credited to Pinsky. Literature priority is provisional; no independent mathematical audit has been carried out.
scientific_limitations: Exact covariance and sign for unconstrained uniform permutations and 3≤k≤n; asymptotics only at fixed k; not a statement of stochastic order, positive association, or longest-subsequence dependence.
title: Fixed points positively covary with every higher-order increasing-subsequence count
